name: github_list_issues
description: This tool allows you to list issues in a GitHub repository with optional filtering by state, labels, assignee, and creation date. Use this tool to answer questions like which issues are open, what is assigned to a person, or what was filed recently. Results are returned newest first and paginated; follow the cursor in the response to fetch subsequent pages. Pull requests are excluded from the results even though the underlying API historically returned them alongside issues.

repository.title: Repository reference
repository.description: Fully qualified reference to a repository, consisting of the owner login and the repository name exactly as they appear in the URL.

owner.description: Account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: Name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

state.description: Indicates the state of the issues to return.

labels.description: Only return issues carrying every one of these labels.

assignee.description: Filter by assignee login. Use the literal string none for unassigned issues.

pagination.title: Pagination options
pagination.description: Standard cursor-based pagination controls shared by every list endpoint in this server.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned in the previous page of results. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page. The server clamps values above the maximum.
